dct_description_sm: The objectives of this study is to determine why female Porcupine caribou have higher renal mercury concentrations than males. This will allow a better understanding of mercury dynamics within the caribou population, enabling more accurate predictions of whether mercury is likely to become a health issue for the caribou or consumers of the caribou.  Also, it will further our understanding of the fate and effects of mercury deposition in the Canadian Arctic.
dct_title_s: What determines mercury concentrations in the Porcupine caribou: assessments of mercury in caribou forage in Yukon, Canada
